glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.guidelines.placeholder: How should the translation read? Tone, form of address, names, wordplay…
glossary.term.instructionsPlaceholder: For example: a pun on “silver” and “hold”, keep both meanings if you can.
glossary.deepl.title: DeepL
glossary.deepl.intro: Send the glossary to your DeepL account, and DeepL keeps these terms in its translations, here and in its own apps. Importing a DeepL glossary brings its translations in here.
glossary.deepl.noKey: Save your DeepL API key to send this glossary to DeepL or import one from there. <link>Account keys</link>
glossary.deepl.sent: DeepL now has {entries, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} in {languages, plural, one {# language} other {# languages}}.
glossary.deepl.imported: Imported from DeepL: {updated, number} terms updated, {created, number} added, {skipped, number} skipped.
glossary.deepl.none: Your DeepL account has no glossary from the language of this work.
glossary.deepl.error.failed: DeepL could not do this right now. Try again later.
glossary.deepl.error.nothing: Translate some terms first, into a language DeepL keeps glossaries for.
glossary.deepl.error.language: Set the language of this work first.
glossary.add.title: Add a term
glossary.add.offline: You seem to be offline. Your text is kept — try again when you’re back online.
glossary.discard.title: Discard this term?
glossary.discard.text: You’ve written instructions for “{term}” that aren’t saved yet. If you leave now they’ll be lost.
glossary.add.fromUniverse: From the {universe} universe · shared by every {universe} story
glossary.add.createEntry: Need context for translators? Create an encyclopedia entry
glossary.add.plainHint: For words that aren’t encyclopedia entries
glossary.add.duplicate: Typing “{term}”? It’s already in this glossary — Enter opens it instead of adding a second one.
glossary.add.linkedHint: {category}{universe} encyclopedia — picture and description are shown to translators
glossary.add.needsAttention: {count, plural, one {# field needs attention} other {# fields need attention}}
glossary.add.visible: Visible to translators right after saving
glossary.intro.universe: Terms here apply to every story in {universe}. A story can add its own terms or override one of these for itself — this list never changes because of a story.
glossary.intro.story: Special words your translators should handle with care. {story} belongs to the {universe} universe, so its terms and guidelines apply here too.
glossary.intro.standalone: This story isn’t part of a universe, so the glossary holds only its own terms. Fan fiction works the same way — it never inherits the canon universe’s glossary.
glossary.plan.title: Editing glossaries is part of the Storyteller plan
glossary.plan.text: You, your team and translators can read everything below. Upgrade to add or edit terms, instructions and guidelines — the owner’s plan covers the whole team.
glossary.add.done: “{term}” added — translators can see it now
glossary.empty.title: No terms yet
glossary.empty.text: Add the names, invented words and idioms translators should handle with care. Start from your encyclopedia or type a word.
glossary.empty.story: Add words that only matter in this story, or override a universe term for it.
glossary.usedBy: Used by {count, plural, one {# story} other {# stories}}
glossary.usedBy.own: {count, plural, one {# own term} other {# own terms}}
glossary.universe.note: Translators of any {universe} story can fill in their language for these terms, so the whole universe reads the same. Terms and instructions stay with the universe team.
glossary.standalone.note: Without a universe there’s no encyclopedia to link to, so every term here is a plain term. Add the story to a universe to link terms to entries.
glossary.plan.note: Glossaries are part of the Storyteller plan. Your team and translators can always read them.
glossary.term.overriddenIn: Overridden in {count, plural, one {# story} other {# stories}}
glossary.translations.title: Translations — the author can edit every language; translators only their own
glossary.guidelines.none: No guidelines yet. Tell translators how the text should read: tone, form of address, names, wordplay.
glossary.languages.keptOne: “{term}” is kept in the original and isn’t counted.
glossary.languages.kept: {count, number} terms are kept in the original and aren’t counted.
glossary.legend.title: Reading the list
glossary.legend.linkedText: The name opens the entry; its picture and description give translators context.
glossary.legend.plainText: Words, phrases and idioms that aren’t encyclopedia entries.
glossary.legend.universeText: Shared by every story in the universe. Change it in the universe glossary, or override it for this story only.
glossary.legend.overrideText: This story uses its own version; the universe term stays untouched.
glossary.panel.empty: No terms yet. The author adds them on the glossary page.
glossary.panel.noneInChapter: No glossary terms appear in this chapter.
glossary.phrase.meaning.label: Translate the meaning
glossary.phrase.coin: Coin one native-sounding word, then use it everywhere.
glossary.phrase.coin.label: Coin a new word
glossary.phrase.formal.label: Use the formal form
glossary.phrase.pun.label: It’s a pun on…
glossary.phrase.consistent.label: Keep consistent with…
glossary.term.hint: as it appears in the text
glossary.term.required: Enter the term as it appears in the text.
glossary.term.formsHint: optional · plural, declensions, nicknames — found in the text too
glossary.term.keepOriginalAll: Keep the original in every language
glossary.term.keepOriginalHint: Translators won’t translate it — good for names.
glossary.phrase.hint: Phrases are inserted into your text — edit or delete them freely.
glossary.translation.offline: Couldn’t save — you seem to be offline. Your text is kept.
glossary.translation.label: {language} translation
glossary.translation.noteLabel: Note for the author and other translators (optional)
glossary.translation.notePlaceholder: e.g. why you chose this word
glossary.empty.translator.title: The author hasn’t added terms yet
glossary.empty.translator.text: When they do, you’ll see each term with their instructions here and in the Glossary tab of the chapter editor, and you can add the {language} translation.
glossary.intro.translator: Write how each term reads in {language}. The terms, the author’s instructions and the other languages are read-only for you; your {language} translations are used in the editor and by the AI and DeepL drafts.
glossary.legend.unsaved: typed, not saved — counts as not translated
glossary.group.sharedTranslations: {language} translations here are shared by every {universe} story
glossary.translator.editorTab: In the chapter editor, the Glossary tab in the sidebar shows the terms of the chapter you are translating.
glossary.translator.canOwn: Your {language} translation, its forms and your note
glossary.translator.cannotTerms: Terms and other forms — the author’s
glossary.translator.noteHint: Unsure about an instruction? Leave a note on your translation — the author sees it next to the term.
glossary.term.storyOverride: story override of a universe term
glossary.keptOriginal.text: The author keeps this term in the original — use it unchanged.
